content_zh:
最美村花，田径校花，体检狂女，邪恶天使，戏曲名角，小家碧玉，大家闺秀，大学女教师，商界铁女，东瀛妖女，东洋之花，最美谍花，最美警花，京圈公主
“使劲！”
“快点儿！”
“加油啊！”
桃花村外的田野上，一男一女在种地。
前面背着绳子拉梨的叫叶开，是个憨子。
后边扶着梨把的叫孙红霞，是桃花村的小寡妇。
叶开八岁那年，村里来了一位白胡子老道。
老道看见叶开，说他骨骼清奇，是武学奇才，送给他两本发黄的书。
一本叫《梯云纵》，是轻功，据说练到一定境界能跳到楼顶。
还有一本《一阳指》，是内功，据说练到最高境界，能活死人肉白骨。
老道走了，叶开却对这两本书着了迷，每天打坐练功。
还拿了把铁锨在自家院子后边的树林里挖坑，腿上绑着沙袋，从坑里往外跳。
时间一晃，十年过去了。
坑越挖越深，叶开练出了惊人的弹跳能力，能跳到两米高的墙头上。
叶开能用一根手指倒立，还能用手指戳碎木板。
虽然没练成这两本书上的绝世神功，但是叶开依然痴迷武学。
他坚信，白胡子老道不会骗他的，有朝一日，他一定会成功的。
叶开练武的同时，并没有耽误学习。
从小到大，都是班里的学霸，

十八岁那年，他以优异的成绩被著名的江南中医药大学录取。
进入大学后，叶开更加痴迷武学，除了上课，就是练功。
叶开长的眉清目秀，非常帅气，身高一米八六，很受女生欢迎。
很多女生主动追求叶开，但是叶开心思全在练武上，辜负了众多妹子的好意。
大三这年，叶开练功走火入魔，神志不清，被迫退学。
叶开妈妈去世早，是爸爸一手带大的。
叶开从家族的骄傲，变成憨子，还被学校送回家里，
一时间村里流言蜚语满天飞，说老叶家肯定上辈子做了什么孽，才受到这样的惩罚。
叶开爸爸受到如此重大打击，一口气没上来，撒手而去。
叶家只剩下叶开一个人，他变成了孤儿。
叶开考上大学时，亲戚朋友都高看他家一眼，经常上门嘘寒问暖。
现在叶开变成了憨子，连生活都不能自理，亲戚们都躲得远远地，没人管他死活。
就在这时候，孙红霞出现了。
孙红霞也是个苦命的女人，嫁了个体弱的老公叫李明。
李明有先天性心脏病，过分激动就会导致心脏骤停。
孙红霞太漂亮了，瓜子脸柳叶眉，高鼻梁樱桃嘴，杨柳细腰，前凸后翘，还有一双大长腿，怎么看怎么好看。
上门提亲的媒人都把孙红霞家的门槛踩烂了好几条。
由于孙红霞家有个弟弟，今年二十了，娶媳妇要花钱，孙家就大大提高了彩礼的标准。
李明家底厚实，花了十头牛的钱，才把孙红霞给娶到家。

The most beautiful village beauty, track and field school beauty, medical examination mad girl, evil angel, famous opera actress, Xiaojiabiyu, lady of the family, female university teacher, strong woman in the business world, Japanese enchantress, flower of the East, the most beautiful spy beauty, the most beautiful police beauty, the princess of the Beijing circle
"Harder!"
"Hurry up!"
"Come on!"
In the fields outside Taohua Village, a man and a woman were farming.
The person pulling the pear with a rope on his back is called Ye Kai, and he is a fool.
The person holding the pear handle behind is called Sun Hongxia, a young widow from Taohua Village.
When Ye Kai was eight years old, an old man with a white beard came to the village.
The old Taoist saw Ye Kai and said that he had strange bones and was a martial arts wizard, so he gave him two yellowed books.
A book called "Ladder to the Clouds" is about Qing Gong. It is said that if you practice it to a certain level, you can jump to the top of a building.
There is also a book called "One Yang Finger", which is an internal skill. It is said that if you practice it to the highest level, you can make human flesh and white bones alive.
The old Taoist left, but Ye Kai became obsessed with these two books and meditated and practiced Qigong every day.
He also took a shovel and dug a hole in the woods behind his yard. He tied a sandbag to his leg and jumped out of the hole.
Time flies, ten years have passed.
As the pit was dug deeper and deeper, Ye Kai developed amazing jumping ability and could jump to the top of a two-meter-high wall.
Ye Kai can stand on his head with one finger and can break wooden boards with his fingers.
Although he has not mastered the peerless magic skills in these two books, Ye Kai is still obsessed with martial arts.
He firmly believes that the old man with white beard will not lie to him, and one day, he will succeed.
While Ye Kai was practicing martial arts, he did not delay his studies.
Ever since I was little, I have always been the top student in my class.
At the age of eighteen, he was admitted to the famous Jiangnan University of Traditional Chinese Medicine with excellent results.
After entering college, Ye Kai became even more obsessed with martial arts. In addition to attending classes, he also practiced martial arts.
Ye Kai has long, handsome features and is very handsome. He is 1.86 meters tall and is very popular with girls.
Many girls took the initiative to pursue Ye Kai, but Ye Kaixin focused solely on practicing martial arts and let down the good intentions of many girls.
In his junior year of college, Ye Kai became obsessed with practicing Kung Fu, became delirious, and was forced to drop out of school.
Ye Kai's mother died early, and it was his father who raised him.
Ye Kai, the pride of his family, turned into a fool and was even sent home from school.
For a time, rumors were flying all over the village, saying that the old Ye family must have done something evil in their previous life to be punished like this.
Ye Kai's father received such a heavy blow that he couldn't even breathe and left.
Ye Kai was the only one left in the Ye family, and he became an orphan.
When Ye Kai was admitted to college, his relatives and friends all looked up to his family and often visited him to inquire about his welfare.
Now Ye Kai has become a fool and can't even take care of himself. His relatives are hiding far away, and no one cares about his life or death.
At this moment, Sun Hongxia appeared.
Sun Hongxia is also a miserable woman, married to a frail husband named Li Ming.
Li Ming has congenital heart disease, and excessive excitement can lead to cardiac arrest.
Sun Hongxia is so beautiful, with an oval face and willow leaf eyebrows, a high nose bridge and a cherry mouth, a slim waist, protruding front and back, and a pair of long legs. She looks good no matter how you look at her.
The matchmakers who came to propose marriage broke down several of the thresholds of Sun Hongxia's house.
Since Sun Hongxia's family has a younger brother who is turning 20 this year, and it costs money to marry a wife, the Sun family has greatly raised the standard of betrothal gifts.
Li Ming's family was rich and he spent the money of ten cows to marry Sun Hongxia.
